_comment: Regions in expectOk are known-working camera APIs — the scheduled endpoint-health workflow fails (and opens an issue) if any of them stop serving cameras. Regions NOT listed are broken or unverified registry entries probed report-only; promote them here once scripts/probe-endpoints.mjs shows them working. Based on the 2026-07-10 probe: 9 regions worked bare, and the IBI-platform regions that returned HTTP 400 are expected to work with the format=json parameter.

notes.OH: publicapi.ohgo.com now returns 401 — requires an API key
notes.MN,IA,NE,CO,MA,IN,KS: endpoints serve an SPA index page — these states migrated off the IBI api/v2 platform
notes.WY,MT,MO,MS,SD,OK,IL,NM: 404 — endpoint URLs are dead and need rediscovery
notes.QC: Quebec WFS returns HTTP 400 — query parameters need rechecking
notes.SC,VA,TN,AL,AR: serve HTML pages, not the IBI JSON API
notes.DE: FirstMap ArcGIS layer returns an error object — layer id or service path changed
